breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in the preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)') which conflicted with the correct instruction for this specific periodic problem in section 7 ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly resolved this by completely omitting the contradictory preamble and only including the correct grid definition ('dx = 1/Nx') in the generated specification, which aligns with the ground truth's approach of removing the incorrect instruction.
